lines.en: Fixies are such itty -bitty creatures.
lines.zh: 修理工是这样小巧的生物。

lines.en: Even when they're magnified It's hard to see their features.
lines.zh: 即使放大也很难看清它们的特征

lines.en: They're tiny, infinitesimal, so small it makes you doubt.
lines.zh: 它们非常小，微乎其微，小到让你怀疑。

lines.en: But if you meet a Fixie, please, Don't let their secret out!
lines.zh: 但如果你遇到了修理工，千万别泄露他们的秘密！

lines.en: The Refrigerator
lines.zh: 冰箱

lines.en: Good job! My homework is all done!
lines.zh: 好，我的作业都做完了

lines.en: Tag, you're it!
lines.zh: 泰德，你被抓住了

lines.en: Ha -ha! Tag, now you're it!
lines.zh: 哈哈！现在轮到你了！

lines.en: Simka, I'm stuck! Help me! Just stay still!
lines.zh: 我被困住了，帮帮我

lines.en: You're really stuck!
lines.zh: 别动。哦，你真的被困住了。

lines.en: Simka, we're not going to leave me, right? We aren't.
lines.zh: 我们不会丢下我的，对吧？我们不会。

lines.en: But I'm afraid, Nolik, you'll be stuck for a while.
lines.zh: 但我恐怕诺里克，你会被困一会儿。

lines.en: Tom Thomas! Help me! What's going on? Look!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯，帮帮我，怎么回事？看

lines.en: This blob of white stuff grabbed onto me!
lines.zh: 这团白色的东西抓住了诺里克

lines.en: to Nolik and I won't let go of him!
lines.zh: 它不肯放开他。哦

lines.en: Oh, it's a piece of gum.
lines.zh: 是一块口香糖。是的

lines.en: It's my bubblegum. Oh, thanks a lot, Tom Thomas!
lines.zh: 是我的泡泡糖。哦，太感谢你了，汤姆·托马斯。

lines.en: Now what's the plan to get me unstuck from here?
lines.zh: 现在有什么办法让我从这里脱身？

lines.en: Here's what we do. It's got to be frozen.
lines.zh: 我们这样做：必须把它冻住。

lines.en: Once I sat on gum too and
lines.zh: 我以前也坐在口香糖上

lines.en: my mom put my pants in the freezer.
lines.zh: 我妈妈把我的裤子放进了冰箱

lines.en: The gum froze up and it came right off.
lines.zh: 口香糖冻住了，它就掉了。

lines.en: I don't want to go into the freezer!
lines.zh: 我不想进冰箱。

lines.en: Don't worry, Nolik. I'll stay right here with you.
lines.zh: 别担心，我会一直陪着你。

lines.en: Just hold on.
lines.zh: 坚持住

lines.en: It won't take long at all. Huh!
lines.zh: 很快就好了。嗯？

lines.en: Why do I need to hold on?
lines.zh: 我为什么要坚持住？

lines.en: The gum's already holding on to me. Simka,
lines.zh: 枪已经抓住了。辛卡

lines.en: do you know why it's so cold in the freezer when outside it's warm?
lines.zh: 你知道为什么外面暖和的时候冰箱里却这么冷吗？

lines.en: I'll explain it to you.
lines.zh: 我来给你解释一下。

lines.en: A refrigerator has a pump that pushes a special liquid through a long tube.
lines.zh: 冰箱里有个泵，它会把一种特殊的液体推过冰箱内部的一根长管。

lines.en: Inside the refrigerator, the liquid in the tube wants to turn into a gas.
lines.zh: 管子里的液体会想要变成气体，为了做到这一点

lines.en: To do that, it takes the heat from everything inside,
lines.zh: 它会吸收冰箱内部所有东西的热量

lines.en: and that makes the refrigerator cool.
lines.zh: 从而使冰箱变冷。

lines.en: Then the pump sucks in the gas and pushes it out as
lines.zh: 然后泵会吸入气体

lines.en: a hot liquid into the tubes on the back of the refrigerator.
lines.zh: 并将其作为热液体排出到冰箱背面的管道中

lines.en: That lets all of the heat collected
lines.zh: 这样就能让热量

lines.en: from the inside escape into the air outside.
lines.zh: 从内部散发到外面的空气中

lines.en: I wish I was somewhere warm. Hold on!
lines.zh: 我真希望自己身处温暖的地方。等等

lines.en: I'll go get us some warm clothes to wear.
lines.zh: 我去拿些保暖的衣服给我们穿。

lines.en: I don't want to hold on. I want to go with you!
lines.zh: 我不想等等，我想和你一起走。

lines.en: Just hang in there! I'm hanging! Tom Thomas!
lines.zh: 坚持住，我坚持住了。汤姆·托马斯

lines.en: Open up!
lines.zh: 打开门。

lines.en: Masiya, do we have any warm clothing to wear?
lines.zh: 我们有保暖的衣服穿吗？

lines.en: Why in the world do you need it?
lines.zh: 你到底为什么需要它？

lines.en: I just do.
lines.zh: 我只是……

lines.en: Well, I need to know what is happening.
lines.zh: 好吧，我需要知道发生了什么。

lines.en: I'm going to go to the bathroom. Hooray!
lines.zh: 万岁！

lines.en: Tom Thomas! Simka! Open up the door!
lines.zh: 汤姆·托马斯！西姆卡！快开门！

lines.en: It looks like I'm going to freeze up in here for good.
lines.zh: 看来我要永远被冻在这里了。

lines.en: A Fixie is constantly surrounded by all sorts of danger.
lines.zh: 固定齿轮自行车总是被各种各样的东西包围着。

lines.en: Inside a dark freezer, a Fixie can lose his way and freeze to death.
lines.zh: 黑暗的冷冻柜里危机四伏。非洲人如果一不留神

lines.en: If he's not paying attention,
lines.zh: 可能会迷路冻死

lines.en: he can drown inside of a washing machine or inside of a dishwasher.
lines.zh: 也可能溺死在洗衣机或洗碗机里

lines.en: And a careless Fixie is always at risk of getting an electric shock.
lines.zh: 粗心的固定齿轮自行车骑手总是面临触电的危险

lines.en: Or suppose there's a short circuit inside of an appliance that starts a fire.
lines.zh: 或者电器内部短路引发火灾。

lines.en: If this happens, you need to run away if you want to survive.
lines.zh: 如果发生这种情况，想要活命就必须逃跑。

lines.en: And what about humans?
lines.zh: 至于人类呢？

lines.en: Well,
lines.zh: 嗯

lines.en: they don't even believe that we Fixies exist at all,
lines.zh: 他们甚至不相信我们固定齿轮自行车骑手的存在

lines.en: So they can accidentally drop something on top of a Fixie,
lines.zh: 所以他们可能会不小心把东西掉在固定齿轮自行车骑手身上，或者踩到我们

lines.en: or step on one, or kick us across the room.
lines.zh: 或者把我们踢到房间另一边。

lines.en: So if we don't get out of the way in time…
lines.zh: 如果我们没能及时躲开……所以

lines.en: So what I'm saying,
lines.zh: 固定齿轮自行车骑手们

lines.en: Fixies, you need to be careful out there and pay attention.
lines.zh: 我的意思是，你们要小心谨慎，注意安全。所以

lines.en: So be smart and stay safe, fellow Fixies!
lines.zh: 聪明点，注意安全，各位固定齿轮自行车骑手们。

lines.en: I don't understand this at all! He was right here!
lines.zh: 我完全不明白，他明明就在这里。

lines.en: Poor Nolik! I wonder where he went? Look at this!
lines.zh: 可怜的诺里克，我想知道他去哪儿了。

lines.en: Footprints! Moloch! You're alive!
lines.zh: 看看这些脚印。诺里克，你还活着！

lines.en: You scared me half to death!
lines.zh: 你吓死我了！

lines.en: How did you get out of there?
lines.zh: 你是怎么出来的

lines.en: Well, you told me about how a refrigerator works.
lines.zh: 你告诉我冰箱的工作原理

lines.en: And so I found that cold tube and
lines.zh: 所以我找到了那根冷管

lines.en: started crawling on it until it got hot,
lines.zh: 开始在上面爬，直到它变热

lines.en: and then I was here! Hey, there's smoke coming out of you!
lines.zh: 然后……嘿，你身上冒烟了

lines.en: We need to cool you down right away!
lines.zh: 我们得赶紧给你降降温。

lines.en: Huh? Where? I don't want to go into the refrigerator!
lines.zh: 嗯？在哪儿？啊，我不想进冰箱。

lines.en: Stop! I was joking! Look how it froze!
lines.zh: 我开玩笑的。你看它都冻成什么样了

lines.en: I could break my teeth on it!
lines.zh: 我都能把它的牙崩掉了。

lines.en: You aren't gonna chew it anymore! I'd never do that!
lines.zh: 你别再嚼它了，我永远不会再嚼了

lines.en: Not after Nolik sat on it!
lines.zh: 诺利克斯坐上去之后我肯定不会再嚼了。

lines.en: Well, you didn't need to stick it where it doesn't belong!
lines.zh: 好吧，你没必要把它塞到不该塞的地方。

lines.en: Hey, I apologize. I'll go and throw it away.
lines.zh: 嘿，我道歉，我去把它扔掉。

lines.en: Maybe you'll try the trash can?
lines.zh: 也许你可以试试垃圾桶。我昨天差点抓到一只
